faq.a: Zakaria is associated with the Arabic form زَكَرِيَّا, whose core sense is zakaria; zechariah (prophet).

faq.q: What is the origin of Zakaria?
faq.a: Zakaria is associated with Arabic. Zakaria is Arabic زَكَرِيَّا (Zakariyyā), the Quranic form of the prophet Zechariah.
Yes — the underlying form زَكَرِيَّا is Arabic.
Zakaria can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zakaria should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zakariyyā is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Zechariah and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Zakaria mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Zakaria is rendered زکریا and carries the sense زکریا، نبی کا نام.

faq.q: What does Zakaria mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zakaria is rendered زکریا and carries the sense زکریا، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is za-ka-ria. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Zakaria?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Zakaria, zakaria. Script forms are زَكَرِيَّا, زکریا, ज़करिया.

faq.q: Is Zakaria a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
